skills.name: goose-context
skills.one_line_purpose: Keep Goose config, Context7, and skills loaded in the guest.
skills.description: Explains GOOSE_PATH_ROOT, the Context7 MCP extension, build-time skill generation from index.json, per-repo skill lookup, and CONTEXT_FILE_NAMES. Use when Goose loses its config, misses a skill, or lacks Context7.

skills.name: hive-runtime
skills.one_line_purpose: Operate inside Hive's tmux, token, and cooldown constraints.
skills.description: Describes Hive's contributor runtime: the tmux session contract, prompt injection, the 15-line output budget, the 55-minute token, the 168-hour cooldown, the agent's GitHub identity, and why selection is Hive's alone. Use when debugging a session.

skills.name: hive-triage
skills.one_line_purpose: Diagnose why an attached contributor is never handed work.
skills.description: Procedure for diagnosing a contributor that authenticates but never receives a task: the public hub endpoints to read, why the hub never pushes work, and the two wrong turns this diagnosis invites. Use when the container connects but no task arrives.

skills.name: image-build
skills.one_line_purpose: Derive and pin the donate-clanker contributor image safely.
skills.description: Covers deriving from the Project Bluefin FSDK base, which Hive contributor runtime pieces donate-clanker layers on top, digest pinning rules, and which registry tags each ref publishes. Use when editing image/Containerfile, a layer, or publish tagging.

skills.name: launcher
skills.one_line_purpose: Change donate-clanker just recipes without breaking foreground.
skills.description: Covers the three donate-clanker just recipes, the foreground guarantee (and why there is no stop command), the VM versus container-only modes, and why the launcher never filters Hive's work. Use when editing just/61-donate-clanker.just.

skills.name: pr-workflow
skills.one_line_purpose: Open donate-clanker pull requests that merge cleanly.
skills.description: Defines Conventional Commit PR titles under squash-only merging, the clanker/<task_id> branch convention, the Hive-Task-Id trailer, and why git hooks are ergonomics not enforcement. Use before branching, committing, or opening a PR.
